name: Sample Collection
description: Deterministic fixture for headless CLI smoke tests. Expects the local mock server (see tests/cli_headless.rs and .github/workflows/tyny-cli-ci.yml) serving GET /health -> 200 on port 8899.

scripts.tests: pm.test('status is 200', function() { if (pm.response.status !== 200) throw new Error('expected 200, got ' + pm.response.status); }); pm.test('body reports ok', function() { if (pm.response.text().indexOf('ok') === -1) throw new Error('missing ok in body'); });
